title: Local Differential Privacy via Dynamic Quantization in Distributed Online Stochastic Optimization
summary: Distributed online stochastic optimization has received extensive attention in large-scale distributed learning and other related fields due to its unique advantage in processing streaming data. However, information exchange through the communication network during the optimization process may lead to privacy leakage. To address this issue, this paper proposes a locally differentially private distributed online stochastic optimization algorithm that employs an elaborately designed dynamic stochastic quantizer to mask the exchanged information prior to communication.
